evidence.title: Goodman Q3 FY26 Operational Update
evidence.excerpt: Goodman's Q3 FY26 operational update identifies ten selected data-centre projects with physical work reported as at March 31, 2026 under the page-1 reporting-date footnote.

metadata.main_table_power_typing_guardrail: Except for TY006's separately and explicitly typed 50 MW gross and 33 IT MW statement, all page-6 FY26 PROJECTED DC WIP PROJECTS, >FY26 SECURED PIPELINE ON CAMPUS, TOTAL, program, campus, and additional-site MW figures remain untyped evidence metadata. They create no normalized capacity rows and are not allocated or added.
metadata.ty006_capacity_scope: TY006 alone receives one planned gross_facility_mw row at 50 MW and one planned critical_it_mw row at 33 MW, both dated March 31, 2026 under the figures footnote. They are alternative dimensions of the same project and are non-additive.
metadata.lax01_program_anchor_guardrail: The LAX01 parent is a locality-scoped non-site program anchor for a reported three-site Los Angeles metro program. The raw site count remains metadata only; the first site's identity and location are unresolved. Neither the wrapper nor the child may be counted as a physical campus, physical site, normalized or resolved unique site, co-location claim, or evidence that the first site carries the approximately 150 MW program total.
metadata.role_guardrail: The page-6 OWNERSHIP column supports only the exact owner role normalized on the campus or asset anchor for the nine selected page-6 rows. Child projects remain role-empty; TY006 has no page-6 ownership row and remains role-empty. Partnership and JV members, direct owners, operators, developers, investors, contractors, utilities, tenants, customers, and users are not inferred.
metadata.classification_guardrail: Enterprise, flexible-deployment, multi-customer, single-customer, fully fitted, powered-shell, and customer-discussion wording creates no normalized operating model, workload, tenant, customer, user, installed hardware, or current-use claim.
metadata.location_guardrail: Only source-reported city, metro, availability-zone, or named-locality strings are retained. LAX01 remains a Los Angeles metro program anchor with its first site unresolved. Coordinates and geometry remain null; no geocode, parcel, address, footprint, building centroid, co-location, or unique-site resolution is inferred.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The disclosure reports no site-level current electrical load, annual energy consumption, measured consumption, PUE, renewable share, onsite generation, water use, or operational energy observation for these normalized projects.
metadata.unique_site_guardrail: Building counts, phase counts, campus wording, and additional-site aggregates create no individual building entities, facility entities, normalized or resolved unique-site count, geometry, or allocation. LAX01's raw reported program_site_count of 3 remains metadata only and is not a resolved site inventory.

metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher photos and artist impressions, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, map imagery, computer vision, and analyst visual interpretation do not contribute to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, classification, roles, coordinates, or geometry.
metadata.activity_date_basis: The page-1 footnote states that all figures are as at March 31, 2026 unless otherwise stated. Pages 7-9 contain no later row-specific observation date, so entity identity and physical-activity observations use March 31, 2026; the page-13 general publication disclaimer does not advance them to the May 26 document date.
metadata.semantic_date_guardrail: Entity and lifecycle observations use 2026-03-31 under the page-1 reporting-date footnote because pages 7-9 state no later row-specific observation date. TY006's two typed capacity observations also use 2026-03-31. Evidence publication remains 2026-05-26, and no observation date is advanced to publication or the July retrieval date.
